title: Spring Boot Examples
description: Each example belongs to one starter lesson. Follow its setup steps before trying it. These examples need the named tools and do not run in this site playground.

examples.title: Return a greeting
examples.description: @RestController makes return values into HTTP responses. GET /hello calls this method.

examples.title: Return named data
examples.description: Spring Boot writes a Map as JSON. Open GET /book.

examples.title: Read a path value
examples.description: @PathVariable reads a value from a named path position. Open GET /hello/Ravi.

examples.title: Use a query default
examples.description: @RequestParam reads a query value. GET /page without n uses the default 1.

examples.title: Parse a whole number
examples.description: An int path input is parsed by Spring. Open GET /double/4.

examples.title: Read a JSON body
examples.description: @RequestBody reads JSON into a Java record. Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip"}.

examples.title: Reject a missing title
examples.description: A handler can check a body value and send 400 when it is not usable. Send POST /books with {"title":"Moon Trip"}.

examples.title: Report a missing resource
examples.description: ResponseEntity lets code choose a status and body. Open GET /missing.

examples.title: Return several records
examples.description: A list becomes a JSON array. Open GET /books.

examples.title: Set reply metadata
examples.description: A response can carry cache instructions. Open GET /note and inspect Cache-Control.

examples.title: Return a location
examples.description: A 302 reply with Location asks a browser to make another request. GET /start ends at /hello.

examples.title: Handle a known failure
examples.description: @ExceptionHandler formats one error type for this controller. Open GET /broken.
